data.description: AI-powered maker education platform for kids ages 10-20. Features AI chatbox that generates code and wiring videos for Raspberry Pi, Arduino, and other circuit boards.
data.mvpScope: LED blink tutorial with AI-generated Python code and wiring guidance

notes: Founder is 13 years old - keep UI simple and inspiring
Proof of concept: blinking LEDs and buzzers
Success metric: Kids get pumped for the next project
AI integration via OpenAI API for code generation
